{{GroupInfobox |title = [https://www.roblox.com/communities/4759500 bark woof] |image = Rocketeer4.png |owner = BelowNatural |type = Public |date = 23 February 2019, 18:49:34 UTC |ranks = 5 |member-count = {{formatnum:{{#invoke:roapid|groups|4759500|memberCount}}}} }} ==Description== '''bark woof''', formally known as '''Bark Woof Games''', is a group which created Roblox games. The group is no longer in use as it has been moved over to [[Paradoxum Games]]. It is owned by BelowNatural and only has five ranks. '''bark woof''' has two hidden games, [https://www.roblox.com/games/2889257441/Apocalypse-Game Apocalypse Game] and [https://www.roblox.com/games/2942604934/Ninja-Game Ninja Game]. Both games have less than 1,000 visits. There was also another game planned to release for '''bark woof''', that being an [[#Trivia|RPG dungeon crawler]], but it only received teasers and was never released. '''bark woof''' does have one item that is on sale, though it is purely meant as a way to give funds to the group. '''bark woof''' formerly had a Discord server, though it no longer exists. An invite to it is still listed on the group, however. ==Ranks== *Member (1) *Contributor (252) *Beef (253) *Razuatix (254) *BelowNatural (255) ==Store==

==Trivia== *An RPG dungeon crawler was meant to be released under this group, but that never happened. Multiple teasers of it were posted by its developers, however. **The final boss of the tutorial dungeon would be a skeleton king. Multiple skeleton enemies also exist and were likely meant for this dungeon. **The first dungeon would have Thesead as the final boss. As Thesead was the golem of the plains, it is likely the enemies there would be themed around nature. **Other Petal enemies were also posted, though it is unclear for what part of the game they were made for. **Various weapons and pieces of armor could be either bought or collected as drops from enemies. As there was a sell area in the world hub, these also likely could be sold. **Another attempt at an RPG dungeon crawler would be made in the [[Paradoxum Games]] group, but that would also never get released.
